svg.title: A Map of State Space Models
svg.desc: Whether the state is continuous or discrete, and whether the maps and noise are linear-Gaussian, places the Kalman filter, EKF, UKF, particle filters, HMMs and regime-switching models on one map.
svg.text: A Map of State Space Models
Is the state continuous or discrete · are the maps and noise linear-Gaussian
A series rewritten in companion form
Approximated by tangents or sigma points
Log variance as the latent state
Regime probabilities vs the optimal path
Three axes for choosing a model
or a finite set of regimes
The left column is the world with closed forms; the right column is the world that needs approximation.
The top row integrates out past states; the bottom row sums them out.
Only the notation differs — the predict-then-update cycle is the same in every cell.
Time-varying T, Z, R gives TVP;
Numbers inside the cells are the sheets in this series that cover that topic.
